What is Jain Entrance Test (JET)?

JET (JAIN Entrance Test) is a university-level exam for admission to UG, PG and MBA programmes offered by JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). The exam is conducted in multiple phase and candidates get the option to choose exam date and slot. Difficulty level of the exam is easy and candidates who qualify it, are shortlised for admission.

JET 2026 will be a remote proctored mode exam of 2.5 hours. Candidates can appear for it from any location. Earlier, the score was used for BTech admission too, but from last year, the university has started accepting JEE Main , CUET , UNIGAUGE , CET, and COMEDK scores for BTech. Those applying for admission to BTech programme of Jain University need not appear for JET.

It is mandatory to clear the JET exam to qualify. The admission through JET programs is based on merit and rank obtained by students in entrance exam. After clearing written exam there will be face group discussion and Personal Interview round.
